meta.title: Custom Module
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Custom Module".

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Custom Module', 'joomlaguide-custom-module', '

A Custom module shows your own content, made with the editor, in a position of the template: a sidebar, the footer and so on. It is often used for announcements, contact details or a banner.

In this tour you create a module Sidebar Announcement with text and an image in the right sidebar, and you move it above the Main Menu.

This tour follows the tutorial 9.1 Custom Module of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_modules"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 9.1 Custom Module', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-custom-module'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-custom-module'), 'Content › Site Modules', '

Click Site Modules in Content.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-custom-module'), 'Create a new module', '

This is the list of the modules of your site. Click New.

', 3, 'bottom', '.view-modules .button-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-custom-module'), 'Custom', '

Joomla shows all module types. Click Custom.

', 4, 'right', '.view-select a.comModulesSelectCard[aria-label$=" Custom"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=select&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-custom-module'), 'Module title', '

Type the title of the module:

Sidebar Announcement

Then click Next.

', 5, 'bottom', '.view-module #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-custom-module'), 'Module content', '
  1. Type the text:
    This site is powered by Joomla
  2. Insert an image: in the editor\'s toolbar, open CMS Content and choose Media. Choose powered_by.png and click the button to insert it.

Then click Next.

', 6, 'top', '.view-module .tox-tinymce,.view-module #jform_content', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-custom-module'), 'Position', '

The position is the place of the module in the template.

Click the field Position and choose Sidebar-right [sidebar-right] in the group Cassiopeia. You can also type sidebar-right to find it.

Then click Next.

', 7, 'left', '.view-module fieldset.form-vertical:has(#jform_position)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-custom-module'), 'Save the module', '

Click Save & Close.

', 8, 'bottom', '.view-module #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-custom-module'), 'Look at your site', '

Click this button with your site\'s name: your site opens in a new tab (in the Joomla Playground you can also click Site in its toolbar).

Your module is in the right sidebar, below the Main Menu: a new module goes to the bottom of its position.

Come back to this tab and click Next: you move it to the top.

', 9, 'bottom', '#header a.header-item-content[target="_blank"]', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-custom-module'), 'Filter Options', '

To change the order of the modules in a position, the list must show only that position.

Click Filter Options.

', 10, 'bottom', '.view-modules .js-stools-btn-filter', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-custom-module'), 'Show only sidebar-right', '

In - Select Position -, choose sidebar-right.

The list reloads and shows only the modules in the right sidebar. Then click Next.

', 11, 'bottom', '.view-modules #filter_position', 2, 6, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1,"requiredvalue":"sidebar-right"}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-custom-module'), 'Ordering', '

Click the arrows in this column heading: the list is now sorted by ordering, and each row gets a handle to drag it.

', 12, 'right', '.view-modules .js-stools-column-order[data-order="a.ordering"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-custom-module'), 'Drag the module to the top', '

Drag Sidebar Announcement by its handle to the top of the list, above Main Menu.

Joomla saves the new order right away. Then click Next.

', 13, 'top', '.view-modules #moduleList tbody', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-custom-module'), 'Well done!', '

Look at your site again and reload the page: Sidebar Announcement is now above the Main Menu.

A module is shown on all pages by default. On its tab Menu Assignment you can choose the pages it shows on: the next tutorial shows how.

', 14, 'bottom', '#header a.header-item-content[target="_blank"]', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
